# Functions permitted to be unreachable from ./cmd/..., one "file symbol" per
# line, each carrying its reason after a '#'. See
# docs/adr/0006-code-must-be-reachable.md.
#
# The gate matches package-qualified names, not bare identifiers: Status,
# Describe and Restart each name methods on several types, and allowing one
# must not silently allow the rest.
#
# This file only ever covers the ./cmd/... gate. The second gate — nothing may
# be unreachable even counting tests — takes no exemptions and has none.
#
# ADR-0006 asked for a reason per entry from the start, and the first version of
# this file shipped as 31 bare lines without them. Writing them down cost three
# entries immediately, because three could not be written honestly:
#
#   Client.Join           a one-line wrapper passing "" to JoinWithCode, which
#                         production called directly. Two spellings of one
#                         request; JoinWithCode is now simply Join.
#   KeypairFromPrivate    derived a public half from an existing private key so
#   PublicFromHostKey     a test could check the derivation round-trips. Nothing
#                         reuses a private key — doRenew generates a fresh
#                         keypair on every renewal with no way to opt out — so
#                         the failure that test described cannot happen. Both,
#                         and the test, are deleted.
#
# A fourth was defended by something imagined rather than something false:
# Loop.RenewNow claimed to exist "for the operator escape hatch (orbit agent
# renew)", a command that has never been built. It stays, because nine e2e tests
# genuinely need it, but its reason below is now the true one.
#
# ConfigPathFor went the same way afterwards: a one-line join duplicating what
# paths.Layout already gives the agent, whose only caller was a test asserting
# it against a literal.
#
# The remaining 24 are one thing: reachable only from tests. That is NOT what
# ADR-0006 says this file is for — it names platform-specific code and
# reflection — so this is still a baseline to shrink, not a category to grow. A
# line added here needs its reason in the commit message too.

# Seams: exported so a test in another package can drive an internal path.
internal/agent/loop.go Loop.RenewNow           # e2e drives renewal directly; doRenew is unexported
internal/agent/loop.go Loop.SetClock           # every guard decision is a deadline comparison, so tests cannot use the real clock
internal/agent/paths/paths.go Layout.StatePath # tests assert where state lands; the agent reaches it through WriteState
internal/api/server.go Server.Handler          # one mux for tests; production mounts the three route sets on separate listeners
internal/db/migrate.go EnsureRoleLogin         # migrations create orbit_app NOLOGIN; giving it a password is a deployment step, done here only by tests
internal/db/migrate.go quoteIdentifier         # reached only from EnsureRoleLogin
internal/db/migrate.go quoteLiteral            # reached only from EnsureRoleLogin

# Adapters: exist so a test can supply behaviour without a real process.
internal/agent/dataplane/supervise.go SupervisorFuncs.Describe # fake supervisor
internal/agent/dataplane/supervise.go SupervisorFuncs.Ensure   # fake supervisor
internal/agent/dataplane/supervise.go SupervisorFuncs.Restart  # fake supervisor
internal/agent/dataplane/supervise.go SupervisorFuncs.Status   # fake supervisor
internal/agent/generation/reload.go ReloaderFunc.Describe      # fake reloader
internal/agent/generation/reload.go ReloaderFunc.Reload        # fake reloader
internal/agent/generation/verify.go VerifierFunc.Describe      # fake verifier
internal/agent/generation/verify.go VerifierFunc.Verify        # fake verifier

# Accessors and alternate forms production does not use yet.
internal/ca/ca.go Issuer.Certificate           # tests read the CA cert back; the issuer signs with it internally
internal/ca/ca.go Issuer.Fingerprint           # same, for the issuer field tests assert on
internal/mesh/node.go Node.MembershipID        # tests identify the control plane's own membership
internal/renewal/renewal.go Policy.Assess      # the loop asks through maybeRenew; Assess is the pure form tests use
internal/renewal/renewal.go Urgency.String     # a Stringer nothing formats yet
internal/policy/compile.go Compiler.All        # the bulk form; the API compiles one membership at a time
internal/fwmatch/parse/parse.go LoadRules      # reads rules off disk; `orbit why` asks the running engine instead

# Deliberate duplication, with a test that keeps the two in step.
internal/api/routes.go ReadOnlyScopes          # store cannot import api, so it carries its own copy
internal/store/session.go ReadOnlyScopes       # that copy; session_test asserts the two agree
